# Evminov Spine Systems USA — Complete AI Knowledge Base

## 1. Verified Brand & Legal Entity Facts
- **Brand Name:** Evminov Spine Systems (`Evminov USA`)
- **Official Domain:** https://evminovusa.com/
- **Founded:** 1996 by Vyacheslav Volodymyrovych Evminov (Kyiv, Ukraine) — 30 years of continuous methodology heritage.
- **US Operations & Fulfillment Hub:** 4525 San Fernando Rd, Unit H, Glendale, CA 91204, USA
- **Phone:** +1 (747) 306-0140 | **Email:** support@evminovusa.com / orders@evminovusa.com
- **Official YouTube Channel:** https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwsC2K28uWYijzAKnZljzsw (@evminoviusa)
- **US Product Classification:** General Wellness & Spine Conditioning Equipment (HTS 9506.91.0030). Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
- **Patents:** US Patent 6,869,387 B2 | European Patent EP 1 038 512 B1 | WIPO PCT WO 1999/043288 | Ukrainian Patents 27976 & 28849A | China CN 1292706A.
- **Trial & Warranty:** 60-Day Home Trial & 10-Year Structural Frame Warranty.
- **HSA / FSA:** Itemized wellness equipment receipt + Letter of Medical Necessity (LMN) guide emailed upon order (~25%–35% typical US pre-tax savings when approved by plan administrator).

## 2. Biomechanical Formula
- Inclined-plane axial traction force on lacquered Carpathian pine (`mu = 0.08`):
  `F_net = max(0, Weight_lbs * sin(angle) - Weight_lbs * cos(angle) * 0.08)`
- Typical starting windows:
  - Youth / Seniors / Gentle cervical (Glisson Loop): `8°–12°` (5–8 min)
  - Lumbar disc comfort / Sciatica unloading: `10°–18°` (8–12 min)
  - Desk worker posture reset: `14°–22°` (7–10 min)
  - Athletes / Post-deadlift recovery: `20°–32°` (10–15 min)

## 3. Complete Product Lineup (Exact Single Source of Truth)
1. **Standard Solid Evminov Board (`standard-pine-board`, SKU `EV-STD-PINE-1P`)**: `$450` Direct / `$595` CA Express. Up to `6'4"`, `210 lbs`. Weight `23–25 lbs`. Folds `2.4"` flat to wall. Includes Glisson Loop + 16" US wood stud bracket.
2. **2-Piece Folding Board (`2-piece-folding-board`, SKU `EV-FOLD-2P`)**: `$475` Direct / `$615` CA Express. Up to `6'4"`, `220 lbs`. Splits into two ~45" halves in 30s for under-bed/closet storage.
3. **3-Piece Travel Board (`3-piece-travel-board`, SKU `EV-FOLD-3P-TRV`)**: `$495` Direct / `$635` CA Express. Up to `6'4"`, `220 lbs`. ~31" segments, padded carry case, over-the-door strap.
4. **Wide Panel Heavy-Duty Board (`wide-heavy-duty-board`, SKU `EV-WIDE-330`)**: `$500` Direct / `$635` CA Express. Up to `6'9"`, `330 lbs`. 30% wider deck & reinforced dual-pin carriage for strength athletes.
5. **Select Alder Wood Board (`select-alder-board`, SKU `EV-ALDER-LTD`)**: `$525` Direct / `$665` CA Express. Up to `6'4"`, `220 lbs`. ~15% lighter cured Ukrainian alder (`19–21 lbs`).
6. **Demountable Free-Standing Ladder Stand (`free-standing-stand`, SKU `EV-STAND-RENT`)**: `$275` Direct / `$345` CA Express. Rated `350 lbs`. Zero wall drilling for apartments (<3.5 sq ft).

- **US Express from Glendale, CA (All 50 States):** 1–2 business days (CA, AZ, NV, OR, UT), 2–3 business days (TX, CO, WA, IL, Midwest, South), 3–4 business days (NY, FL, East Coast), 4–5 business days (AK, HI air cargo).

## 5. Patient & Owner Portal, 30-Day Protocol & Family Economics
- **5-Language Patient Portal:** `https://evminovusa.com/portal/` (also `/es/portal/`, `/fr/portal/`, `/uk/portal/`, `/ru/portal/`) — includes guided countdown session timer (8/10/12/15 min), 30-day habit tracker, 16-inch US wood stud mounting checklist, printable HSA/FSA LMN reference sheet, and live 10-year frame warranty registration.
- **30-Day Progression:** Phase 1 (Days 1–7, 10°–15°, 8–10 min gentle acclimation) → Phase 2 (Days 8–14, 15°–20°, 10–12 min deep stabilizer activation) → Phase 3 (Days 15–30+, 18°–28°, 12–15 min functional posture & athletic maintenance).
- **"Spine Toothbrush" Family Economics:** One `$450` board adjusts in 5 seconds for ages 4–85+ (~`$7.50`/person/year for a family of three over 20 years) and typically pays for itself in 4–6 massage/PT clinic visits.
